title: A constructible abelian sheaf killed by n is a constructible sheaf of Z/n-modules
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme, $n\ge1$ an integer and $C$ a constructible abelian sheaf on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-abelian-sheaf] with $n\cdot\mathrm{id}_C=0$. Let $\tilde C$ be $C$ with its unique structure of sheaf of $(\mathbf Z/n)_T$-modules extending its abelian structure [lem-weil-pbc-sheaves-killed-by-n-zmod-modules], an object of $\Mod(T_{\Et},\mathbf Z/n)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $\tilde C$ is a constructible sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] (with $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/n$), and every stratification witnessing the constructibility of $C$ witnesses that of $\tilde C$. (Ingredients: the module inverse image along an immersion $\iota_k$ has the abelian inverse image as underlying abelian sheaf (cf. [lem-weil-pbc-exchange-forget-coefficients] (1)), and is killed by $n$; a finite abelian group $A$ with $(\iota_k^{-1}C)|_{V}\cong\underline A$ on a nonempty $V$ has $nA=0$ ($A$ is a stalk), so it is a finite $\mathbf Z/n$-module, and the constant abelian sheaf $\underline A$ is the underlying abelian sheaf of the constant sheaf of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules with value $A$, both being the sheafification of the same presheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]; an isomorphism of abelian sheaves between sheaves of $\mathbf Z/n$-modules is $\mathbf Z/n$-linear by [lem-weil-pbc-sheaves-killed-by-n-zmod-modules] (3). The converse also holds and is not part of this node. This is the general-scheme form of [lem-weil-pbc-constructible-torsion-modules-agree], which states it for curves.)
